branches.name: extlib_b_only
branches.purpose: Measure A incremental contribution by removing it; source ablation, original guard preserved

branches.name: extlib_a_only
branches.purpose: Measure B incremental contribution by removing it; source ablation, original guard preserved

branches.name: extlib_abe_gap_fill
branches.e_policy: Only use E when AB has no valid accepted reference hit; invalid E preserves exact AB output

branches.name: extlib_abe_compete
branches.e_policy: E may replace a valid AB hit only with a strictly higher score; ties/invalid E preserve exact AB output

branches.name: extlib_ab_bprec_trusted
branches.b_precursor_policy: Replace only finite measured m/z with supported adduct, compatible mode, neutral/adduct theoretical consistency and mismatch from original neutral +/- H window; otherwise original fallback
